title: Lateen mobile search opening report
description: What the search opening budget measured on one commit in mobile Chromium: the first opening, which loads the search index, and the median of the repeat openings, both in whole milliseconds, next to the checked-in ceilings they were compared with. The commit identifies the run instead of a timestamp.

commit.description: The commit the measurement ran on. It identifies the run instead of a timestamp.

firstMs.description: The first opening: click to visible dialog, index load included.

repeatMs.description: The median of five further openings, each after the dialog was closed again.

baseline.description: The checked-in CI ceilings the two measurements were compared with.

ok.description: True when neither measurement is over its baseline.
